goals: Verify that REMOTE_FILE successfully loads valid remote files of various types and returns the expected data structures
Verify that REMOTE_FILE raises appropriate exceptions when provided with invalid or unsupported file URLs
activities: Execute REMOTE_FILE with a valid file URL and file type
Assert that the output is an instance of the expected output type
Execute REMOTE_FILE with an invalid file URL and verify that a ValueError is raised
Construct the expected error message for an unsupported URL schema
Execute REMOTE_FILE with an unsupported file URL schema and verify that an InvalidSchema exception is raised with the expected error message
